verdict.rationale: Data residency and region selection is a fair axis for a SaaS CRM like Freshsales. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions choosing a storage region, data centers, or residency options. The pack covers only API endpoints, Freddy AI features, pricing items (sandbox, audit logs, field-level permissions) and failed probes, none of which address where data is stored.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
